items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The source change is three small guards, e.g. `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj): setattr(rel_obj, self.field.name, instance)`. They match the surrounding style and reuse the existing comments and names.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The core fix reuses the existing is_cached API and is minimal. But the agent left a 169-line debug script, `reproduce_issue.py`, in the repo. It monkeypatches whole copies of get_prefetch_queryset, so it is a debug leftover full of copy-pasted logic.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The guards only skip overwriting an already-cached relation, and the existing behaviour stays as the fallback. Nothing is swallowed and there are no magic constants. Hidden tests pass with P2P 85/85.

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The reverse-FK manager is guarded with `self.field.is_cached(rel_obj)`. ReverseOneToOneDescriptor gets the same guard (`if not self.related.field.is_cached(rel_obj)`), as does ForwardManyToOne. When the child isn't cached, the reverse relation is still set.
